sentences.text: Graciliraptor is a genus of microraptorian dromaeosaurid dinosaur, a name meaning "graceful thief".
This animal was estimated to be about 90 centimeters long, though some measurements suggest a total body length of one meter.
In 2010, Gregory S. Paul estimated the dinosaur to weigh only 1.5 kilograms.
A thin bone sheath connects the back joints of the tail vertebrae, extending over an eighth of the next bone to stiffen the middle tail.
The holotype fossil, which is the specimen the species is based on, was discovered in Beipiao, Liaoning Province, China.
Xu Xing and Wang Xiaoling named and described this dinosaur in 2004.
Later research classified Graciliraptor within the subfamily Microraptorinae.
Fossils are found in the lowest portions of the Yixian Formation, specifically the Lujiatun Member.
The time range for Graciliraptor is from the Barremian to the Aptian, between 125.77 and 119.57 million years ago.
